entries.title: Crew work goes to the subscription with the most allowance to spare
entries.body: When Firstmate picks a model for crew work, a subscription with 10% or less of its allowance left now goes after every subscription with more left, so a nearly used plan is protected. A task's record explains its model under Why this model: the reason it was chosen, and the subscriptions it was compared with and how much each had left.

picture.alt: A task record's Why this model explains that Claude was picked over Codex, which had 10% or less left
